blocks.prompt: 5 Suppose the inflation rate for the cost of a basket of goods is 8% per year. If the current price level is Rs. 1000, use differential equation to find the price level after 5 years.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh inflation (mehngai) ka sawal hai. Mehngai mein qeemat badhti hai, aur badhne ki raftar maujooda qeemat ke proportional hoti hai.
Is liye model \(\frac{dP}{dt} = 0.08P\), kyunke \(8\% = 0.08\).
Diya kya hai? Aaj ki qeemat \(P(0) = 1000\).
Find kya karna hai? 5 saal baad qeemat, \(P(5)\).
Plan: hal karein, constant nikalein, t = 5 rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya: inflation 8% salana, \(P(0) = 1000\) rupay; \(t\) saalon mein.
Maloom karna: \(P(5)\).
Tareeqa: growth model \(\frac{dP}{dt} = kP\), \(k = 0.08\) (Section 4.1.1 ka Example 3; Example 11 ka ulta, wahan deflation tha).

Differential equation hal karein
\[\dfrac{dP}{dt} = 0.08P\]
\[\int\dfrac{dP}{P} = 0.08\int dt\]
\[P = Ce^{0.08t}\]
Kyun: variables alag kiye, integrate kiya (\(\ln|P| = 0.08t + C_1\)), phir dono taraf \(e\) liya. Plus sign is liye ke qeemat badh rahi hai.
Dhyan dein: 8% ko 8 nahi, 0.08 likhna hai.

\(P(0) = 1000\) lagayein
\[1000 = Ce^{0} \Rightarrow C = 1000\]
\[P = 1000e^{0.08t}\]
Kyun: 'current price level' yani aaj ki qeemat, jo t = 0 par hai.

\(t = 5\) rakhein
\[P(5) = 1000e^{0.08(5)}\]
\[= 1000e^{0.4}\]
\[\approx 1000(1.49182)\]
\[\approx 1491.82\]
Kyun: 5 saal baad ki qeemat chahiye; calculator se \(e^{0.4} \approx 1.49182\).

Tasdeeq
Agar mehngai saal mein ek dafa judti to \(1000(1.08)^{5} \approx 1469.3\) hota. Continuous (har lamhe) growth thori zyada hoti hai, is liye 1491.8 maqool jawab hai \(\checkmark\)
blocks.final_answer: 5 saal baad qeemat taqreeban Rs. 1491.8 hogi.
